title: Digital Clock widget add custom time format
line: The Digital Clock can now show the time in any custom format, such as 12-hour time without AM/PM or the date and time on one line.
explanation: The clock face always used the region's time format: only the date part could be customized, so there was no way to drop AM/PM, add a leading zero to 24-hour time or arrange the clock freely. Open MR plasma-workspace!6498 replaces the "Show date" checkbox with a "Clock format" choice (Time only, Time and date, Custom); Custom takes a free Qt date/time format for the whole clock face, where a bare h follows the "Time display" setting so h:mm gives 12-hour time without AM/PM, and %{timezone} inserts the time zone.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add a custom clock format option

The clock face could only show the region's time format, so there was no
way to get e.g. 12-hour time without AM/PM or a stacked layout. Replace
"Show date" with a Clock format choice whose Custom mode takes a format.

BUG: 393956

media.caption: Master: Appearance settings have only a date format, nothing for the time
With the MR: Clock format "Custom" with the reporter's format ddd dd. MMM h:mm and a live preview
Master: the panel clock in the region format
With the MR: the panel clock shows Thu 26. Nov 8:03 (12-hour, no AM/PM)
